newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil TAM shares slide 11.09 pct by mid-morning.
newsitem.headline: Brazil TAM shares slide 11.09 pct by mid-morning.

text.p: Shares in Brazilian airline TAM plummeted in morning trade on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange in reaction to an accident Wednesday involving a TAM aircraft in which one person was killed.
TAM preferred shares plunged 11.09 percent by mid-morning to 56.90 reais in line with market expectations of a steep fall.
In Wednesday's accident, a passenger was sucked from a Fokker-100 TAM aircraft and fell to his death after an explosion at the back of the plane ripped a hole in the fuselage.

The accident came only eight months after another TAM plane crash. In November, another Fokker-100 TAM aircraft crashed into houses in a densely populated area of Sao Paulo, killing 98 people, including two on the ground.
A total of 16 trades in TAM preferred shares were carried out by mid-morning and financial volume reached 53,000 reais. ((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
